messages.author: 0723ca501ba6b79c
messages.subject: Mplus not available (Mac)
parts:
Hi all, 
I am having a hard time getting Mplus and R to connect on my Mac (11.6). 
I'm running RStudio Version 4.1.1, MplusAutomation 1.0.0 and I have already installed XQuartz and I'm not getting any kind of error message when loading the tcltk package... 
Any more ideas what could cause this problem? 
Many thanks :)
Anja

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Mplus not available (Mac)
parts:
Hi there, Anja,

Do you have Mplus installed on the machine? For example, on my Mac, it's installed here: /Applications/Mplus. You won't be able to use MplusAutomation without this. If you have it installed in a non-standard location, you'll need pass the path to Mplus using the Mplus_command argument of readModels.

Hope this helps,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: Mplus not available (Mac)
parts:
Hi Michael, 

thanks for your reply! 
Yes, Mplus is directly installed on the machine. For whatever reason, mplusAvailable() still tells me that its not, but it works now - I am able to run models through R. 
I had some issues with the line breaks in my original input files, but after creating them directly with createModels and a template file, it worked fine now. 
On my first try, I copied a displayed terminal command to my terminal directly and had to grant the terminal access rights to my files - maybe that is interesting for someone else as well. 
In short: It works now, but I don't know why.

Cheers
Anja
